name: com.atsuvanced.debugger
description: UI Toolkit based in-game debugger compatible with SRDebugger API (SRDebug / SROptions).

samples.description: Many sample options: every built-in type, 3-level categories, groups, custom views per value type, dynamic categories, pages, log generators and a stress test.
Imports SROptions.cs into Assets so that existing 'partial class SROptions' code keeps working.
A fully custom page (form + header toolbar), a custom tab and an option that opens a page.
An IBugReporter that POSTs bug reports (JSON + text + screenshot) to your server with UnityWebRequest.
